note: The verified facts of phase 6 (T027, T028, T029, T030). The build appends no record by itself that the tasks reserve to a person: for every live check the owner ruling of 2026-09-30 applies — the part a person runs is never run and never faked here, the hermetic half runs on Linux, and the live half is recorded as `unverified` with its reason. The hermetic half of each probe is `packages/harness/tests/live/hermetic-probe-rehearsal.ts`, loopback only, no real credential.

records.subject: model-list endpoint of a provider the consumer uses (live, T027)

check.name: model-list-unbilled
check.method: One GET of the provider's model list with the consumer's real credential, to learn whether the call is unbilled and whether the credential is taken as declared (bearer or x-api-key).

result.evidence: unverified — the live GET against a real provider with a real credential is a part a person runs and the build never runs and never fakes (owner ruling of 2026-09-30). Reason: the build holds no real credential and must not send one to a third-party host or risk a billed call. The hermetic half is confirmed: packages/harness/tests/live/hermetic-probe-rehearsal.ts on Linux 2026-10-27 proved the machinery — one GET, the credential in the declared header to the one host the descriptor names and no other, the value registered with the redactor at the moment of use, a redirect refused with no request to a second host, and no credential value in any trace (proof: .specstride/features/146-harness-discovery/gates/proofs/T027-T028-hermetic-run.txt). What remains for the person: run one curl of the real model list with the real credential and append a record with outcome confirmed or refuted.
result.runBy: unverified — awaits a person; hermetic half run by the build on Linux

records.subject: model-list endpoint of a gateway (live, T028)

check.name: gateway-cross-provider
check.method: One GET of the gateway's model list, to learn whether the list names models of providers other than the gateway's own.

result.evidence: unverified — the live GET against a real gateway is a part a person runs and the build never runs and never fakes (owner ruling of 2026-09-30). Reason: the build must not touch a third-party host; the task is not paid, but the run belongs to a person with a real gateway endpoint. The hermetic half is confirmed: the same rehearsal on Linux 2026-10-27 proved that the reading of a gateway model list keeps models of several providers (openai, anthropic, google in the stub list), so a cross-provider list is visible to discovery as one candidate model each (proof: .specstride/features/146-harness-discovery/gates/proofs/T027-T028-hermetic-run.txt). What remains for the person: one curl of the real gateway model list and a record with outcome confirmed or refuted.
result.runBy: unverified — awaits a person; hermetic half run by the build on Linux

records.subject: every test of feature 146 on a macOS runner (live, T029)

check.name: tests-on-macos
check.method: npm test --workspace packages/harness -- --test-name-pattern 146 on a macOS runner.

result.evidence: unverified — the macOS runner part is a part a person runs and the build never runs and never fakes (owner ruling of 2026-09-30). Reason: no macOS runner is reachable from this Linux build host, and provisioning one is outside what discovery may execute. Until a person runs the suite on macOS, every macOS statement of this feature stays `unverified` and nothing of the feature asserts macOS behaviour (the PID-namespace isolation of tests/isolate.ts is Linux-only by design; its macOS path is untested). What remains for the person: run the one command above on a macOS machine with Node 22 or later and append a record with the pass count.
